summary.text: TELEKIOSKEN INNLANDET AS is a private limited company registered in Hamar, founded 1989-08-16. Telekiosken Innlandet AS sells telephony and data products and services, along with other business connected to this. Its statutory purpose is the sale of mobile phones and accessories, and other products and services that naturally go together with this. It was previously named NORDBY AS until 2010-12-06. Its main industry code is 47.400: retail sale of information and communication equipment. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 75 156 868 NOK and the annual result was 5 500 849 NOK; operating income was up from 60 429 092 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 3 366 813 NOK in 2024 to 5 500 849 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 3 964 346 NOK in 2024 to 4 465 195 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 16 on 2025-12-13 to 18 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
